The film follows the sexually-charged adventures of Dr. Bill Harford, who is shocked when his wife, Alice, reveals that she had contemplated having an affair a year earlier.  He embarks on a night-long adventure, during which he infiltrates a massive masked orgy of an unnamed secret society.
